description: Dataset of prediction and mitigation process for coastal natural hazards for Alexandria, Egypt is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by figshare. .This dataset helps to validate and regenerate the numerical simulation for the prediction of the coastal flood hazard (coastal natural hazard) for Alexandria, Egypt.For Extreme Value Analysis for Alexandria, Egypt, please use the dataset file to generate the Extreme Value Analysis For the Spectral Wave Model Dataset for Alexandria, Egypt, the output dataset for the ... Coverage: Egypt. The portal files it under the publisher figshare. Its tags are Civil engineering not elsewhere classified. The repository dates the deposit 2024; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
